name: Lévis member savings and credit cooperative
description: A local cooperative organized member savings and credit in Lévis.

impact.note: One cooperative applying European models; it brought savings and credit to working people in Quebec, and the caisse and credit-union movements followed directly.

date.basis: Date of the documented episode, not a universal origin.

events.statement: The Caisse populaire de Lévis began operations; twelve members deposited a total of $26.40.
events.scope: The Lévis cooperative, not a universal first.

evidence.supports: Dates the first operations and records twelve deposits totalling $26.40.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest documented episode in this scoped record, not a global origin.

caveats: Deposits document use, not actual loans, inclusive eligibility or distribution of credit. European cooperatives preceded the Lévis institution.

research.note: Initial source pass. Independent review read the Québec heritage register’s synthesis, including the 1900 founding, 1901 operations, twelve depositing members and nominal deposit total.

measures.subject: Lévis caisse
measures.conditions: Members depositing on the specified day, not total membership.
